verdict.rationale: Veo 3's docs say it can add dialogue to generated videos, with all audio produced natively alongside the video. A hands-on community user was 'blown away at how well the audio/video matches up', which corroborates synchronized speech. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of lip movement matched to spoken dialogue, details on how users supply their own dialogue lines, and independent evaluations specifically of lip-sync accuracy.
